term: principles from which genus and differentia are taken
definition: In ST I q3a5 co first proof, what supplies the constitutive differentia stands to what supplies the genus as act to potency; the sensitive/intellectual natures are the illustration. This is a metaphysical account of the underlying principles, not a claim that written terms or merely classified objects are material parts. In the third proof, shared generic quiddity and differing esse motivate a real essence/esse distinction; generic commonality is not silently identified with equality of every subject’s complete essence. The act/potency relation between the supplying principles has not been identified with an instantiated InPotency predicate over the existing Being/Respect parameters.
